title: Bike Engine Components Manufacturer in Nigeria | Autologic
description: Autologic Industries exports bike engine components for Nigeria, precision-made to OEM tolerances with quality checks at every production stage.
banner_desc: Accurately machined engine parts for motorcycles that work long, hot days in Nigeria.
hero_sub: Tight Tolerances for Engines That Never Get a Day Off
hero: Commercial motorcycle engines in Nigeria are worked harder than most: long hours, heavy loads, dust in the dry season and water in the wet. Our bike engine components for Nigeria are made to tolerances that help those engines last between rebuilds.
Parts come from our own CNC machining and die casting lines in an IATF 16949 certified plant, and they fit without the filing or shimming that poor-quality parts need.
Design, materials and production follow international standards, and components are tested for difficult road and weather conditions.

faq_intro: Questions from Nigerian importers, traders and workshops about our engine parts.
faqs: How do I know the parts suit my bikes?
Share model names, part numbers or a sample and we confirm fitment before you order.
What quality checks do you run?
Checks run at each stage in our IATF 16949 certified plant, and parts are tested for tough road and weather conditions.
Can you make a part from our drawing?
Yes. Our casting and CNC lines can produce it after a feasibility review, with samples for approval first.
Can bulk and custom items go in one order?
Yes. Both go through the same ordering process with clear prices and delivery dates.
By sea to Lagos in protective packing, with documents prepared for your clearing agent.
Can engine parts travel with clutch parts?
Yes. Many buyers combine them with hubs, plates and housings.
